purpose: Display accepted GWAS/post-GWAS results with explicit evidence boundaries; recipes never refit upstream statistics.

global_genetic_correlation.title: Global genetic-correlation heatmap or method-agreement panel
evidence_boundaries: Display documented LDSC, GNOVA, or HDL estimates without refitting.
Keep method identity and the declared multiple-testing rule visible.
Genetic correlation is not causal evidence.

local_genetic_correlation.title: Local genetic-correlation Manhattan or trait-by-region map
evidence_boundaries: Use only completed local-correlation output and its documented genome build.
Do not infer local signals from global correlation values.
Retain region and chromosome ordering from the source analysis.

pleiotropy_placo_plus.title: PLACO+ pleiotropic-locus map or circular dendrogram
evidence_boundaries: Use the accepted PLACO+ lead catalog after the declared clumping step.
Do not mix legacy PLACO rows into the primary figure.
A pleiotropic association is not proof of a shared causal variant.

coloc_shared_loci.title: PLACO+ and pairwise-colocalisation shared-locus dendrogram
evidence_boundaries: Display PP.H4 and the declared region window (for example ±250 kb) from the accepted coloc output.
ANNOVAR output is a candidate SNP-to-gene mapping, not a causal-gene claim.
Do not display HyPrColoc evidence until serial and parallel results have been reconciled.

mendelian_randomization.title: MR estimate forest plot or method-agreement panel
evidence_boundaries: Display completed MR estimates and uncertainty without rerunning MR.
Keep estimand, method, effect scale, and reference line explicit.
Do not combine incompatible estimands into one pooled estimate.

gene_level.title: Gene-level Manhattan, lollipop, or candidate-gene matrix
evidence_boundaries: Use an explicit gene-coordinate source and preserve the upstream gene-level metric.
Do not infer coordinates or causal status from a gene symbol alone.
Distinguish ANNOVAR candidate mapping from MAGMA or other gene-level evidence.
